metadata.name: didar
metadata.description: Animated WebGL shader background in the God Rays style. Ether variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#140A00, #FF6D00, #FFC300, #FFF1B8). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
metadata.author: parsavashghani10

metadata.name: mix
metadata.description: Pure CSS gradient background in the Layered Tide style, made with the 21st.dev Gradient Builder. 6-color palette (#0136E4, #123A6B, #DC2C2C, #DD2C2C, #530097, #6500B8). Features: film grain, vignette. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and page backgrounds.
metadata.author: paulkatz996
